description: Write the PTBuilder script for the current topology to a file, for users who prefer a file to copying from chat. Use an absolute path: relative paths resolve against $MCP_TRACER_DIR if set, else the server's working directory (now /tmp/churn-4bp5gvaz), which MCP clients often set arbitrarily. "~" is the user's home directory. Same validation as generate_script: errors block the export unless force: true. Refuses to replace an existing file unless overwrite: true. The user then copies the whole file into Extensions > Builder Code Editor in a new, empty Packet Tracer workspace and clicks Run.

force.description: Export even if validation reports errors.

overwrite.description: true = replace the file if it already exists.

path.description: File to write, e.g. C:\labs\vlans.js. Only .js or .txt file names are accepted; .js is added when the file name has no extension. Absolute path recommended.

name: export_script
title: Export PTBuilder script
